goal: Close GAP-3 by extending the W0-07 CI secret-access boundary to executable .mts and .cts TypeScript modules while preserving the existing exact loader allowlist and sanitized diagnostics.

acceptanceCriteria.text: (GAP-3) A tracked .mts file containing direct process.env access outside the exact loader allowlist makes the checker exit non-zero and report the file and line without revealing the accessed secret name.

(GAP-3) A tracked .cts file containing direct process.env access outside the exact loader allowlist makes the checker exit non-zero and report the file and line without revealing the accessed secret name.
(GAP-3) The committed CI secret-access command and its complete regression suite pass after the classifier change, proving existing covered source types and allowlist behavior remain intact.

edgeCases.text: (GAP-3) Extension matching is case-insensitive, consistent with the existing classifier contract.
(GAP-3) A similarly named non-source extension such as .mts.txt remains outside the executable-source scan.
(GAP-3) Adding .mts and .cts does not broaden the exact loader allowlist; a new file such as packages/config/src/secrets.mts is still treated as outside the loader.
(GAP-3) Failure output identifies only the offending path and line and does not echo the environment key or source line.
